parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number in paging. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in paging. Default value: 10.
